records.title: PRADHAN MANTRI GRAM SADAK YOJANA IN TAMIL NADU
details:
(a) to (e): (iii) Under PMGSY IV, the State of Tamil Nadu has surveyed 7 unconnected habitations for 
providing all-weather road connectivity, out of which 4 have been verified to be eligible by 
National Rural Infrastructure Development Agency (NRIDA). The Detailed Project Reports 
(DPRs) are received for the 4 road projects and are under consideration.
